requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Official local county surveyor/GIS custody page retrieved.
Official county ArcGIS Hub bootstrap retrieved; site metadata identifies Lake County Indiana GIS and a parcel-data download section.
Anonymous service metadata retrieved. One polygon layer, native service CRS EPSG:2245 / latest WKID 2966.

Layer schema retrieved. Safe identity fields observed: OBJECTID (OID) and PARCELID (Parcel Identification Number). Owner, address, tax, legal-description and link fields were not requested for features and are excluded from retained samples.

Bounded anonymous query with where IncMuni='Hammond', outFields=OBJECTID,PARCELID, returnGeometry=true, outSR=4326, resultRecordCount=3 returned three polygons. Retained in hammond-parcels-sample.geojson with only canonical PARCELID in each feature property.

Exact WUP-point and small/wider EPSG:4326 envelope attempts returned zero features. This is recorded only as an exact-point/map-query miss and is not treated as citywide absence; the Hammond-scoped query independently returned geometry.

fieldMapping.PARCELID: Parcel Identification Number; retained as canonical native identity
fieldMapping.OBJECTID: ArcGIS object identifier; observed but not retained where PARCELID exists

sourceIdentity.crs: EPSG:2245 (NAD83 / Indiana East, US survey feet); response reprojected by service to EPSG:4326 for retained GeoJSON

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Lake County, Indiana parcel boundaries; Hammond is a city within Lake County.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Hammond-filtered public parcel response with three polygons; countywide service extent is documented in service metadata.
coverageAssessment.targetPointHitInterpretation: No exact-point feature was returned; this does not establish absence.

remainingUncertainty: The service is countywide rather than a Hammond-only custodian, and the exact WUP point did not intersect a returned feature. Parcel freshness is governed by the publisher's changing parcel fabric. No runtime adapter qualification was performed.
nextStep: Serial reviewer should independently qualify the Lake County service, including current endpoint behavior, CRS handling, Hammond coverage, native PARCELID stability, and adapter safety before admission.
